principles: Label behaviour over time, never a single frame. Every interval must meet its label's minimum duration.
Every label is decided from observable criteria in the video, not from interpretation, intent or the outcome.
A detected person is not a drowning person. Raised arms alone, closeness of faces to the water alone, an unusual posture alone, or a submersion alone are NOT distress.
distress requires several distress criteria together for at least its minimum duration; otherwise use another label or 'uncertain'.
Staged distress is performed only by trained adult volunteers with lifeguards present; no scenario involves children.
When unsure, use 'uncertain'. Uncertain intervals are excluded from training and evaluation.

labels.label: normal_swim
criteria: Forward displacement is clearly visible over the interval (roughly >= 0.3 m/s or crossing lane markings).
A regular, repeating stroke and/or kick pattern is visible.
The head clears the water regularly to breathe (front crawl turns, breaststroke lifts, backstroke face up).
The body is closer to horizontal than vertical.
not_this_label_when: Progress stops for more than 2 s: end the interval and label the next part separately.
Movement is splashing or play without progress: use 'play'.

labels.label: idle
labels.summary: Calm presence in the water without swimming: standing, floating, resting at the wall, calm treading.
criteria: Little or no displacement (roughly < 0.2 m/s).
The head is stably above the water; breathing is unhurried.
Movements are relaxed: looking around, talking, adjusting goggles, holding the wall or a float.
No repeated going under and coming up.
not_this_label_when: The head repeatedly drops to the waterline while the body is vertical and arms press down: consider 'distress' only if its criteria are met, else 'uncertain'.

labels.label: play
labels.summary: Voluntary recreational activity that is not lap swimming: splashing, jumping, games, throwing, interacting with others.
criteria: Energetic but controlled movement, often with other people or objects (ball, noodle).
Arms may be raised, waving or splashing; the person turns towards others, laughs or calls out.
Brief voluntary submersions followed by controlled resurfacing are part of the activity.
Movement direction changes often; there is no sustained forward progress.
not_this_label_when: The person is alone, vertical, head at the waterline and arms pressing down repeatedly for >= 3 s: check the 'distress' criteria.

labels.label: dive
labels.summary: Intentional entry or underwater movement: dive or jump in, surface dive, underwater swim, breath-hold game.
criteria: The going-under is preceded by a deliberate action (push-off, tuck, jump, surface dive, breath taken).
Under water the person moves purposefully or holds still in a controlled way.
The person resurfaces under control (no gasping struggle) and resumes another activity.
The interval covers from the start of the deliberate action to resurfacing.
not_this_label_when: No deliberate action before going under, or no resurfacing: do not guess; use 'uncertain' and record a submersion event if it is a staged submersion scenario.

labels.label: distress
labels.summary: Instinctive-drowning-response-like behaviour (staged by trained adult volunteers).
criteria: Head at or below the waterline for more than half of the interval, mouth at water level, head tilted back when it surfaces.
No forward progress.
Body vertical in the water, no effective kick.
Arms press down or extend laterally on the water surface (not waving overhead, not stroking).
No voluntary communication: does not call out or wave for help.
labels.decision_rule: Label 'distress' only when at least the first three criteria hold together for >= 3 s. One criterion alone is never enough.
not_this_label_when: Raised or waving arms with the head well above water (signalling, play): use 'play' or 'idle'.
A submersion with controlled resurfacing: use 'dive'.
Calm floating or treading with the head clear: use 'idle'.

labels.label: uncertain
labels.summary: The annotator cannot decide from the video (occlusion, glare, out of frame, conflicting cues).
criteria: Use whenever no other label's criteria are clearly met.

reserved_contract_classes.drowning: Contract class kept for compatibility. It is NEVER annotated in staged sessions (no real drowning is staged); real incidents are recorded as GroundTruthEvent rows of type 'drowning' by the safety officer.

interval_csv.time_base: t_media seconds from the start of video_file (same clock as FrameResult.t_media)
interval_csv.track_id: the track ID drawn by the system's overlay (run_video / dashboard) for this session; track_uid = cam_id:session_id:track_id

agreement.metric: Cohen's kappa and percent agreement over a 0.5 s grid on the overlapping time of each (session, track)
agreement.target: set by the team before labelling starts (open decision); report the value with the dataset
